keyPoints.en: Homeostasis keeps physical and chemical factors in the body (temperature, glucose, water, pH, CO₂) within a narrow range.
keyPoints.bm: Homeostasis mengekalkan faktor fizikal dan kimia badan (suhu, glukosa, air, pH, CO₂) dalam julat yang sempit.

keyPoints.en: Negative feedback: deviation → receptor → control centre → effector → correction → back to normal.
keyPoints.bm: Suap balik negatif: penyimpangan → reseptor → pusat kawalan → efektor → pembetulan → kembali normal.

keyPoints.en: Too hot: sweating, vasodilation, hair erector muscles relax, lower metabolism.
keyPoints.bm: Terlalu panas: berpeluh, vasodilatasi, otot erektor rambut mengendur, metabolisme rendah.

keyPoints.en: Too cold: shivering, vasoconstriction, hair stands up, more thyroxine/adrenaline (higher metabolism).
keyPoints.bm: Terlalu sejuk: menggigil, vasokonstriksi, rambut tegak, lebih tiroksina/adrenalina (metabolisme tinggi).

keyPoints.en: Blood glucose: high → insulin (glucose → glycogen); low → glucagon (glycogen → glucose).
keyPoints.bm: Glukosa darah: tinggi → insulin (glukosa → glikogen); rendah → glukagon (glikogen → glukosa).

question.en: Why does your skin look red after running?
question.bm: Mengapa kulit kelihatan merah selepas berlari?

answer.en: Skin arterioles dilate (vasodilation) so more blood flows near the surface to lose heat.
answer.bm: Arteriol kulit mengembang (vasodilatasi) supaya lebih banyak darah mengalir dekat permukaan untuk membebaskan haba.

tip.en: Glucagon raises glucose when the glucose is 'gone'.

keyPoints.en: Urinary system: kidneys → ureters → bladder → urethra. Each kidney has about a million nephrons.
keyPoints.bm: Sistem urinari: ginjal → ureter → pundi kencing → uretra. Setiap ginjal mempunyai kira-kira sejuta nefron.

keyPoints.en: Ultrafiltration: high pressure in the glomerulus forces water, glucose, salts, urea into Bowman's capsule.
keyPoints.bm: Ultraturasan: tekanan tinggi dalam glomerulus memaksa air, glukosa, garam, urea ke dalam kapsul Bowman.

keyPoints.en: Reabsorption: all glucose and amino acids, most water and salts return to the blood (mainly in the proximal tubule).
keyPoints.bm: Penyerapan semula: semua glukosa dan asid amino, kebanyakan air dan garam kembali ke darah (terutamanya di tubul proksimal).

keyPoints.en: Secretion: extra urea, H⁺, drugs and toxins move from blood into the distal tubule.
keyPoints.bm: Rembesan: urea tambahan, H⁺, ubat dan toksin bergerak dari darah ke tubul distal.

keyPoints.en: Osmoregulation: high blood concentration → more ADH → more water reabsorbed → less, concentrated urine.
keyPoints.bm: Pengosmokawalaturan: kepekatan darah tinggi → lebih ADH → lebih air diserap semula → air kencing sedikit dan pekat.

question.en: Why are proteins not found in the filtrate?
question.bm: Mengapa protein tidak terdapat dalam hasil turasan?

answer.en: They are too large to pass through the walls of the glomerulus and Bowman's capsule.
answer.bm: Molekulnya terlalu besar untuk melalui dinding glomerulus dan kapsul Bowman.

tip.en: More ADH = less urine. Alcohol blocks ADH, so you urinate more.
tip.bm: Lebih ADH = kurang air kencing. Alkohol menyekat ADH, jadi lebih kerap kencing.

keyPoints.en: Kidney stones: minerals crystallise in concentrated urine → severe pain; prevented by drinking enough water.
keyPoints.bm: Batu karang: mineral menghablur dalam air kencing pekat → sakit teruk; dicegah dengan minum air secukupnya.

keyPoints.en: Kidney failure: often caused by uncontrolled diabetes and high blood pressure; urea builds up in blood.
keyPoints.bm: Kegagalan ginjal: sering disebabkan diabetes dan tekanan darah tinggi yang tidak terkawal; urea terkumpul dalam darah.

keyPoints.en: Treatment: haemodialysis (machine), peritoneal dialysis, or kidney transplant.
keyPoints.bm: Rawatan: hemodialisis (mesin), dialisis peritoneum, atau pemindahan ginjal.

keyPoints.en: Urinary tract infections: bacteria in the urethra/bladder; prevented by hygiene and drinking water.
keyPoints.bm: Jangkitan saluran kencing: bakteria dalam uretra/pundi kencing; dicegah dengan kebersihan dan minum air.

question.en: Why must dialysis fluid have the same glucose concentration as normal blood?
question.bm: Mengapa cecair dialisis perlu mempunyai kepekatan glukosa yang sama dengan darah normal?

answer.en: So glucose doesn't diffuse out of the blood — only waste like urea is removed.
answer.bm: Supaya glukosa tidak meresap keluar dari darah — hanya bahan buangan seperti urea disingkirkan.

tip.en: Dialysis fluid has NO urea, so urea diffuses out of the blood.
tip.bm: Cecair dialisis TIADA urea, jadi urea meresap keluar dari darah.
